name: Falling
overview: Scripture reveals that falling can signify spiritual failure, temptation, or physical stumbling, yet it also emphasizes God's sustaining help and the believer's resilience. Proverbs warns that pride leads to a fall, while a righteous person may fall multiple times but will rise again, supported by the Lord's light in times of darkness. Psalms acknowledges adversities designed to cause falling, but affirms divine assistance in overcoming them. Ultimately, all have sinned and fall short of God's glory, underscoring the need for Christ-centered restoration and perseverance.
